bear_assumptions: USD 2.00 normalized forward diluted EPS at 16x; product growth normalizes, foundry losses and investment stay heavy, and offering dilution plus competitive setbacks suppress per-share recovery.
base_assumptions: USD 3.90 normalized forward diluted EPS at 20x; product demand remains healthy, yield and utilization improve, and offering proceeds fund a gradual external-foundry ramp without mature returns.
bull_assumptions: USD 5.20 normalized forward diluted EPS at 25x; AI compute demand, product share, advanced-node execution and credible external-foundry wins produce substantial operating leverage after offering dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price offers sufficient margin of safety and scenario returns clear every economic and relationship gate while product growth, process execution, margin recovery, external-foundry demand and post-offering cash conversion remain durable; downgrade further if competitiveness, process ramps, foundry demand, margins, leverage, dilution, funding, export controls or policy support deteriorate.
